about_p1: Knox Detail Pro exceeded my expectations with their top-tier car detailing service. My vehicle looks brand new, with every inch meticulously cleaned and polished to perfection. The team was professional, thorough, and clearly passionate about their work. I highly recommend Knox Detail Pro to anyone looking for quality detailing that brings out the best in their car!
about_p2: Did a great job. 14 year old car that had never been deep cleaned, and had been through 3 dogs. Car interior came back spotless, and all the embedded dog hair in the fabric seats was gone. Highly recommend!
